  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: This is the test-visible consequence of the unresolved-directory fallback treating `config_override=True` commits as requiring confirmation.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:443-448, 639-646 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A findings report with valid IDs below the cycle limit does not schedule another review, so the follow-up staleness check may not run after the stale threshold elapses.
  WHY: The age check runs only when the gate is invoked; without a later PR event or another per-PR trigger, stalled follow-ups can remain held without the promised CRITICAL alert.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1528-1530, 1555-1557 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fallback's inline comment describes an env-wrapped-only check while its condition checks `config_override`.
  WHY: Until the condition is corrected, the comment and implementation describe different command classes, making the guard's effective trust boundary unclear.
